events.title: 🎃 Midnight Moving Crew Demo – The Halloween Update is LIVE!
events.summary: Hey everyone, Halloween is right around the corner, so we’ve put together a pretty substantial update for the Midnight Moving Crew demo! Based on a lot of the feedback we’ve received over the past few weeks, we’ve overhauled a few core systems, added new ghost hunting tools, and squashed some annoying bugs.Here’s a breakdown of what’s new:Multiple Ghost Types & Detection EquipmentHouses are no longer just haunted by a generic entity—we’ve introduced multiple distinct ghost types to the game.
